units.maximum_tokens: Conservative UTF-8 byte upper bound; not provider-billed tokens
units.maximum_latency_ms: Monotonic cooperative wall-clock milliseconds; remote adapters must enforce I/O deadlines
units.maximum_cost_units: Logical work units; not monetary cost

resource_accounting: Unique selected canonical resources; paths and conflicts consume member edge/node budgets.
conflict_policy: Reserve both sides of a discovered contradiction as an atomic selection; report exclusion rather than return one side as a fallback.
